  (admitted : ASPProof.SearchRouteCanonicalPayloadDigestReplay.CanonicalShortcutPayload → Prop)
  (collisionEvidence : ASPProof.SearchRouteSafeReplayModeNegotiation.CollisionFreeEvidence digest admitted)
  (left right : ASPProof.SearchRouteCanonicalPayloadDigestReplay.CanonicalShortcutPayload)
  (leftAdmitted : admitted left) (rightAdmitted : admitted right)
  (digestEquality : ASPProof.SearchRouteSafeReplayModeNegotiation.DigestEqualityEvidence digest left right)
  (canonicalEquality : ASPProof.SearchRouteSafeReplayModeNegotiation.CanonicalEqualityEvidence left right),
